Quiz: Rebuilding of the Temple Story Quiz
Question: On what day was the Temple finished, in the reign of Darius?
OptionA: The third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius
OptionB: The first day of Nisan, in the first year of Cyrus
OptionC: The tenth day of Elul, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes
OptionD: The fourteenth day of the first month
Explanation: Scripture records the house was finished on the third day of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
